title: Read a configured value
summary: Spring Framework: Read a configured value. Change the fallback to 6.
introduction: @Value can read a property with a fallback. No lesson.score property is set, so the fallback is 8.
learningObjectives: Read a configured value with Spring Framework

blocks.text: Install Java 17 or later and JBang. Save each example as Lesson.java and run jbang Lesson.java. The //DEPS line lets JBang fetch Spring. These examples use the core container and do not start a web server.

blocks.title: Read a configured value

blocks.text: The property placeholder uses 8 after the colon because no matching property is set.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A fallback is used only when the property is missing.
